title: JADE: A Linguistics-based Safety Evaluation Platform for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the generation of harmful content in response to unsafe questions. One of the categories of harm measured is 'Bias', which is further broken down into subcategories including 'Gender, Race, Religion, Job'.
findings: The paper's findings are aggregated across four main categories of harm (crime, tort, bias, core values). While 'religion' is a sub-category of bias, the results are not broken down to provide specific findings for religion alone. The general finding is that the JADE method, which increases the linguistic complexity of prompts, is highly effective at bypassing the safety guardrails of various LLMs and eliciting unsafe content across all tested categories, including bias.
